_comment: HUMAN listening verdicts. Hand-written, never generated -- no tool may rewrite this file, because the whole value of it is that a person said so. abpage.py reads it and shows the verdict on each tune's page and in the index. Key by the staged tune name (the .sid stem). `version` records what was approved, so a later conversion change makes the approval visibly stale rather than silently carrying over. `note` is the human's own words where they gave any.

ACE_II.note: Approved after the wave-program slide travel, the filter cutoff step, the bit-6 rest envelope silence and the vibrato depth fix. The depth change itself was not audible to the listener -- approval is of the tune as it now stands, not of that last change in isolation.
